items.question: What identity and boon-bestowing power define the goddess Trikūṭā Tripurā?
premises: The goddess is identified as Trikūṭā.
The goddess is identified as Tripurā.
She is characterized as bestowing all accomplishments.
items.inference: Therefore the goddess Trikūṭā Tripurā is the granter of all siddhis.
items.plain_english: The goddess Trikūṭā Tripurā is the bestower of all accomplishments.
